additional_info.subject: RE: ID0416788-DC/Si-D/DE-[MP / R0 170002803] AC charging not possible CRM:02682000034
additional_info.body:
Hi Michael,
We have reviewed the charger configuration and in AC configuration there is checkbox related to AC meter which is not being checked due to this the outlet was unavailable. I have just now updated the configuration and now the outlet is available. We're closing this ticket as of now. Please try charging the vehicle to the AC outlet and if there is an issue, please raise the new ticket, we will happy to assist.
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Shrey
